summary: Kenon Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that an ICSID ad hoc committee dismissed Peru's annulment application of an October 2023 arbitration award. The award totals approximately $200 million including interest; Kenon's estimated share is $93 million net of capital provider obligations. The capital provider receives up to 55% of net proceeds after reimbursement of $12 million committed. This is a legal proceeding update, not a corporate restructuring transaction. No deal terms, board recommendation, or regulatory clock apply. Watch for enforcement actions or payment from Peru.
